    local b=Instance.new("TextButton",p)
    b.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,43)
    b.BackgroundColor3=C.el
    b.Text=txt
    b.TextColor3=C.white

    b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    b.AutoButtonColor=false
    Instance.new("UICorner",b).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,8)

    b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        b.BackgroundColor3=C.hover
    end)

    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        b.BackgroundColor3=C.el
    end)

    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fn)
    return b
end

local function toggle(p,txt,fn)
    local b=button(p,txt.."  [OFF]",function() end)
    local on=false

    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        on=not on
        b.Text=txt.."  ["..(on and "ON" or "OFF").."]"
        fn(on)
    end)

    return b

-- KEY ESP
--==================================================

local keyESP=false
local keyObjects={}

local function clearKeys()
    for _,x in ipairs(keyObjects) do
        if x then x:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(keyObjects)
end

local function getPart(o)
    if o:IsA("BasePart") then
        return o
    end

    if o:IsA("Model") then
        return o.PrimaryPart
            or o:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
    end
end

local function updateKeys()
    clearKeys()
    if not keyESP then return end

    local n=0

    for _,o in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if o.Name:lower()=="key"
        and (o:IsA("Model") or o:IsA("BasePart")) then

            n+=1

            local h=Instance.new("Highlight",gui)
            h.Adornee=o
            h.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            h.FillColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,220,0)
            h.OutlineColor=C.white
            h.FillTransparency=.45
            table.insert(keyObjects,h)

            local p=getPart(o)

            if p then
                local bb=Instance.new("BillboardGui",gui)
                bb.Adornee=p
                bb.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(130,35)
                bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)
                bb.AlwaysOnTop=true
                bb.MaxDistance=2000

                local t=Instance.new("TextLabel",bb)
                t.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                t.BackgroundTransparency=1
                t.Text="KEY "..n

                t.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0)
                t.TextStrokeTransparency=0
                t.TextSize=16
                t.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold

                table.insert(keyObjects,bb)
            end
        end
    end
end

toggle(visual,"Key ESP",function(on)
    keyESP=on

--==================================================
-- POLE / SCREWDRIVER ESP
--==================================================

local itemESP=false
local itemObjects={}

local function clearItems()
    for _,x in ipairs(itemObjects) do
        if x then x:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(itemObjects)
end

local function isRealItem(o)
    if not (o:IsA("Model") or o:IsA("BasePart")) then
        return false
    end

    local n=o.Name:lower()

    return n=="pole" or n=="screwdriver"
end

local function updateItems()
    clearItems()
    if not itemESP then return end

    local detected={}

    for _,o in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if isRealItem(o) then
            local p=getPart(o)

            if p then
                local duplicate=false

                for _,d in ipairs(detected) do
                    if o:IsDescendantOf(d) or d:IsDescendantOf(o) then
                        duplicate=true
                        break
                    end
                end

                if not duplicate then
                    table.insert(detected,o)

                    local name=o.Name:lower()=="pole"
                        and "POLE"
                        or "SCREWDRIVER"

                    local h=Instance.new("Highlight",gui)
                    h.Adornee=o
                    h.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    h.FillColor=Color3.fromRGB(0,255,120)
                    h.OutlineColor=C.white
                    h.FillTransparency=.45
                    table.insert(itemObjects,h)

                    bb.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(160,35)
                    bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)
                    bb.AlwaysOnTop=true
                    bb.MaxDistance=2000
                    bb.Parent=gui
                    table.insert(itemObjects,bb)

                    local text=Instance.new("TextLabel",bb)
                    text.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                    text.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    text.Text=name
                    text.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(80,255,120)

                    text.TextStrokeTransparency=0

--==================================================
-- ESP VER (MONOCROMA)
--==================================================

local verESP=false
local verObjects={}

local function clearVER()
    for _,v in ipairs(verObjects) do
        if v then v:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(verObjects)
end

local function updateVER()
    clearVER()
    if not verESP then return end

    local detected={}

    for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") then

            local n=obj.Name:lower()
            local isVER=(n=="ver")
            local isMonster=n=="monster" or n:match("^monster[%w_%.%-]*$")~=nil

            local hum=obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root=obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local moving=false

            if hum and root then
                moving=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude>2
            end

            if isVER or (isMonster and moving) then
                local part=getPart(obj)

                if part and not detected[obj] then
                    detected[obj]=true

                    local h=Instance.new("Highlight",gui)
                    h.Adornee=obj
                    h.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    h.FillColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,40,40)
                    h.OutlineColor=C.white
                    h.FillTransparency=.35
                    table.insert(verObjects,h)

                    local bb=Instance.new("BillboardGui",gui)
                    bb.Adornee=part
                    bb.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(180,38)
                    bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3,0)
                    bb.AlwaysOnTop=true
                    bb.MaxDistance=2500
                    bb.Parent=gui
                    table.insert(verObjects,bb)

                    local txt=Instance.new("TextLabel",bb)
                    txt.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                    txt.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    txt.Text=isVER and "VER" or "MOVING MONSTER"
                    txt.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,60,60)
                    txt.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0)
                    txt.TextStrokeTransparency=0
                    txt.TextSize=16
                    txt.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

toggle(visual,"ESP VER (Monocroma)",function(on)
    verESP=on
    updateVER()
end)

local dragging=false
local dragStart,startPos

head.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging=true
        dragStart=i.Position
        startPos=main.Position
    end
end)

U.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
    if dragging and (
        i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then

        local d=i.Position-dragStart

        main.Position=UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale,
            startPos.X.Offset+d.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset+d.Y
        )
    end
end)

U.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging=false
    end
end)

main.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)

    TweenInfo.new(.35,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
    {Size=UDim2.fromOffset(600,390)}
):Play()

-- Helpers
local function normalize(name)
	name = tostring(name):lower():gsub("^%s*%d+_", ""):gsub("[^%a]", "")
	return name
end

local function cleanLootName(rawName)
	local cleaned = rawName:gsub("^%s*%d+_", ""):gsub("_", " ")
	return cleaned:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
end

local ItemsByKey = {}        -- normalized -> {key, clean, num}
local CleanToKey = {}
local CleanLootOptions = {}

for _, raw in ipairs(RawLootList) do
	local clean = cleanLootName(raw)
	local key = normalize(raw)
	ItemsByKey[key] = { key = key, clean = clean, num = tonumber(raw:match("^%s*(%d+)")) or 0 }
	CleanToKey[clean] = key
	table.insert(CleanLootOptions, clean)
end

SelectedItems[normalize("Button")] = true

-- Cache: instance name -> item info (or false). Avoids re-running string ops on every part each scan.
local InfoByName = {}
local function itemInfo(name)
	local info = InfoByName[name]
	if info == nil then
		info = ItemsByKey[normalize(name)] or false
		InfoByName[name] = info
	end
	return info or nil
end

local function tierFromNumber(n)
	for _, t in ipairs(RarityTiers) do
		if n >= t[2] and n <= t[3] then return t[1] end
	end
	return "Unknown"
end

local function readRarity(inst)
	local a = inst:GetAttribute("Rarity") or inst:GetAttribute("rarity")
	if a ~= nil then return tostring(a) end
	local v = inst:FindFirstChild("Rarity")
	if v and v:IsA("ValueBase") then return tostring(v.Value) end
	return nil
end

-- Returns lowercase rarity, source ("game" or "guess")
local function getRarity(inst, info)
	local cur = inst
	for _ = 1, 4 do
		if not cur or cur == Workspace then break end
		local r = readRarity(cur)
		if r then return r:lower(), "game" end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return tierFromNumber(info.num):lower(), "guess"
end

local function isPlayerStuff(inst)
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p.Character and inst:IsDescendantOf(p.Character) then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function getHRP()
	local c = LocalPlayer.Character
	return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

-- Tween (with hard snap at the end so you always arrive)
local function sellingNow() return IsSelling end

local function tweenToCFrame(targetCFrame, duration, abortIf)
	local hrp = getHRP()
	if not hrp then return end
	duration = duration or TravelSpeed

	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	local tween = TweenService:Create(hrp, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { CFrame = targetCFrame })
	tween:Play()
	task.wait(duration + 0.05)
	tween:Cancel()

	-- something else (selling) took over the character; don't snap it back to this target
	if abortIf and abortIf() then return end

	if hrp.Parent then
		hrp.CFrame = targetCFrame
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
end

-- Sell
local function getSellTarget()
	for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if (obj:IsA("BasePart") or obj:IsA("Model")) and (obj.Name:lower():find("sell") or obj.Name:lower():find("base")) then
			local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if part then return part end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function executeSell()
	if IsSelling then return end
	IsSelling = true

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local hrp = getHRP()
		if not hrp then return end

		local originalCFrame = hrp.CFrame
		local sellPart = getSellTarget()

		if sellPart then
			tweenToCFrame(sellPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), TravelSpeed)
			task.wait(0.1)

			local sellPrompt = sellPart.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or sellPart:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
			if sellPrompt then fireproximityprompt(sellPrompt) end

			local touch = sellPart:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TouchTransmitter", true)
			if touch then
				firetouchinterest(hrp, sellPart, 0)
				task.wait(0.05)
				firetouchinterest(hrp, sellPart, 1)
			end
		end

		if UnequipLootRF then UnequipLootRF:InvokeServer() end
		if SellAllRF then SellAllRF:InvokeServer() end
		if ResetBackpackRF then ResetBackpackRF:InvokeServer() end

		task.wait(0.1)
		if hrp and hrp.Parent then
			tweenToCFrame(originalCFrame, TravelSpeed)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[Sell error]", err) end

	IsSelling = false
end

-- Find the nearest world item that passes the item whitelist OR the rarity whitelist
local function isWanted(inst, info)
	if SelectedItems[info.key] then return true end
	if next(SelectedRarities) then
		local rarity = getRarity(inst, info)
		if SelectedRarities[rarity] then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function findNearestWanted(fromPos)
	local bestPart, bestRoot, bestDist = nil, nil, math.huge
	local now = tick()

	for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			local info = itemInfo(obj.Name)
			if info and isWanted(obj, info) and not isPlayerStuff(obj)
				and not (RecentlyTried[obj] and now - RecentlyTried[obj] < 1.5) then

				local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
				local prompt = part and (obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true))
				if part and prompt then
					local d = (part.Position - fromPos).Magnitude
					if d < bestDist then
						bestPart, bestRoot, bestDist = part, obj, d
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return bestPart, bestRoot
end

local function collectOne()
	if IsSelling or PredictorBusy or not AutoCollectEnabled then return end

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local hrp = getHRP()
		if not hrp then return end

		local part, root = findNearestWanted(hrp.Position)
		if not part then return end

		RecentlyTried[root] = tick()
		local startCFrame = hrp.CFrame

		tweenToCFrame(part.CFrame, TravelSpeed, sellingNow)
		task.wait(0.05)

		if not IsSelling then
			local prompt = root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
			if prompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
			firetouchinterest(hrp, part, 0)
			firetouchinterest(hrp, part, 1)
			task.wait(0.05)
		end

		if ReturnToStart and not IsSelling then
			tweenToCFrame(startCFrame, TravelSpeed, sellingNow)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[Collect error]", err) end
end

-- Auto buy: buys the strongest affordable cutter in the shop
local FailedBuys = {}

local function buyBestAvailableCutter()
	if not (GetShopStateRF and BuyCutterRF) then return end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local state = GetShopStateRF:InvokeServer()
		if type(state) ~= "table" or type(state.CuttersData) ~= "table" then return end

		local balance = tonumber(state.Balance) or 0
		local owned = state.OwnedCutters or {}
		local data = state.CuttersData

		-- strongest regular cutter already owned
		local bestOwnedMult = 0
		for name, isOwned in pairs(owned) do
			local info = data[name]
			if isOwned and info and info.Type == "Default" and (info.DamageMult or 0) > bestOwnedMult then
				bestOwnedMult = info.DamageMult
			end
		end

		-- buyable, affordable, and better than what we have
		local candidates = {}
		for name, info in pairs(data) do
			if not owned[name]
				and info.Type == "Default"
				and not info.EventOnly and not info.GamePassOnly and not info.HiddenUntilOwned
				and (info.Price or 0) > 0 and info.Price <= balance
				and (info.DamageMult or 0) > bestOwnedMult
				and not (FailedBuys[name] and tick() - FailedBuys[name] < 30) then
				table.insert(candidates, { name = name, mult = info.DamageMult })
			end
		end
		table.sort(candidates, function(a, b) return a.mult > b.mult end)

		-- don't swap away from an "OP" cutter (those give a bonus over your best cutter)
		local currentInfo = data[state.CurrentCutter]
		local keepCurrent = currentInfo and currentInfo.BestOwnedDamageBonus ~= nil

		for _, c in ipairs(candidates) do
			BuyCutterRF:InvokeServer(c.name)

			-- verify the purchase by re-reading the shop
			local newState = GetShopStateRF:InvokeServer()
			local bought = type(newState) == "table" and newState.OwnedCutters and newState.OwnedCutters[c.name]

			if bought then
				if not keepCurrent and EquipCutterRF then EquipCutterRF:InvokeServer(c.name) end
				break
			else
				FailedBuys[c.name] = tick() -- e.g. world not unlocked yet; retry later
			end
		end
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[AutoBuy error]", err) end
end

-- Uses a price stored on the item if the game has one, otherwise falls back to item number
local ValueNames = { "Price", "Value", "SellPrice", "SellValue", "Worth", "Cost", "Coins" }
local function readGameValue(inst)
	local cur = inst
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		if not cur or cur == Workspace then break end
		for _, n in ipairs(ValueNames) do
			local a = cur:GetAttribute(n)
			if type(a) == "number" then return a end
			local v = cur:FindFirstChild(n)
			if v and v:IsA("ValueBase") and type(v.Value) == "number" then return v.Value end
		end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

-- Spawned items sorted most expensive first, plus what they were ranked by
local function scanItems()
	local found, allGame = {}, true

	for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			local info = itemInfo(obj.Name)
			if info and not isPlayerStuff(obj) then
				local parentInfo = obj.Parent and itemInfo(obj.Parent.Name)
				if not (parentInfo and parentInfo.key == info.key) then
					local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
					local prompt = part and (obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true))
					if part and prompt then
						local gv = readGameValue(obj)
						if gv == nil then allGame = false end
						table.insert(found, { root = obj, part = part, info = info, gameValue = gv })
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for _, f in ipairs(found) do
		f.value = (allGame and f.gameValue) or f.info.num
	end
	table.sort(found, function(a, b) return a.value > b.value end)

	return found, (allGame and #found > 0) and "game price" or "item number"
end

local function listText(found)
	if #found == 0 then return "No items spawned right now." end
	local hrp = getHRP()
	local lines = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(#found, MAX_LIST) do
		local f = found[i]
		local dist = hrp and math.floor((f.part.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude) or 0
		table.insert(lines, i .. ". " .. f.info.clean .. " (#" .. f.info.num .. ") - " .. dist .. " studs")
	end
	if #found > MAX_LIST then
		table.insert(lines, "+" .. (#found - MAX_LIST) .. " more")
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

-- 3D picture of an item inside a ViewportFrame
local function setThumb(vp, root)
	vp:ClearAllChildren()
	pcall(function()
		local clone = root:Clone()
		if not clone then return end
		for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then d:Destroy() end
		end
		clone.Parent = vp

		local cf, size
		if clone:IsA("Model") then
			cf, size = clone:GetBoundingBox()
		else
			cf, size = clone.CFrame, clone.Size
		end

		local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
		cam.Parent = vp
		vp.CurrentCamera = cam
		local dist = math.max(size.Magnitude, 1) * 1.1
		cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + Vector3.new(1, 0.7, 1).Unit * dist, cf.Position)
	end)
end

-- Drag by the header (mouse and touch)
local function makeDraggable(handle, target)
	local dragging, dragStart, startPos

	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = target.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			target.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		end
	end)
end

local function panelHeight(n)
	if not PanelExpanded then return HEADER_H end

local function updatePanel(found)
	if not (PicturesOn and PanelGui) then return end
	local hrp = getHRP()
	local count = math.min(#found, MAX_PICS)

	for i, row in ipairs(PanelRows) do
		local f = found[i]
		if f then
			local dist = hrp and math.floor((f.part.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude) or 0
			row.item = f
			row.frame.Visible = true
			row.name.Text = f.info.clean
			row.sub.Text = "#" .. f.info.num .. "  -  " .. dist .. " studs"
			row.btn.BackgroundColor3 = stateColor(f.root)
			if row.key ~= f.info.key then
				row.key = f.info.key
				setThumb(row.vp, f.root)
			end
		else
			row.item = nil
			row.frame.Visible = false
			row.key = nil
		end
	end

	PanelEmpty.Visible = (count == 0)
	applyPanelSize(count)
end

local function setPictures(on)
	PicturesOn = on
	if on then
		local ok, err = pcall(buildPanel)
		if not ok or not PanelGui then
			PicturesOn = false
			warn("[Pictures error]", err)
			notify("Pictures failed", tostring(err))
			return
		end
		PanelGui.Enabled = true
		updatePanel(LastScan)
	elseif PanelGui then
		PanelGui.Enabled = false
	end
end

closePanel = function()
	setPictures(false)
	if PicturesToggle then
		pcall(function() PicturesToggle:Set(false) end)
	end
end

local function refreshPredictor()
	local found, source = scanItems()
	LastScan = found

	local top = found[1]
	local title = top and ("Most expensive available: " .. top.info.clean) or "Most expensive available: none spawned"
	local content = listText(found)
		.. "\n\nMost expensive in the game: " .. TopItem.clean .. " (#" .. TopItem.num .. ")"
		.. "\nRanked by " .. source

	if ListParagraph then
		pcall(function() ListParagraph:Set({ Title = title, Content = content }) end)
	end
	updatePanel(found)
end

-- Collects queued items one at a time (green = collecting, blue = waiting)
local function processQueue()
	if PredictorBusy then return end
	PredictorBusy = true

	task.spawn(function()
		local hrp0 = getHRP()
		local startCFrame = hrp0 and hrp0.CFrame

		while #PanelQueue > 0 do
			while IsSelling do task.wait(0.2) end

			local q = table.remove(PanelQueue, 1)
			CurrentTarget = q.root
			updatePanel(LastScan)

			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				local hrp = getHRP()
				if not hrp then return end
				if not (q.root.Parent and q.part.Parent) then return end -- already gone

				tweenToCFrame(q.part.CFrame, TravelSpeed, sellingNow)
				task.wait(0.05)

				local prompt = q.root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or q.part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
				if prompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
				firetouchinterest(hrp, q.part, 0)
				firetouchinterest(hrp, q.part, 1)
				task.wait(0.1)
			end)
			if not ok then warn("[Predictor error]", err) end

			CurrentTarget = nil
			refreshPredictor()
		end

		if startCFrame and getHRP() then
			tweenToCFrame(startCFrame, TravelSpeed, sellingNow)
		end

		PredictorBusy = false
		refreshPredictor()
	end)
end

enqueueItem = function(f)
	if CurrentTarget == f.root or inQueue(f.root) then return end
	table.insert(PanelQueue, { root = f.root, part = f.part, info = f.info })
	updatePanel(LastScan)
	processQueue()
end

local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

    Click = {Id = "rbxasset://sounds/button.wav", Volume = 0.6},
    Toggle = {Id = "rbxasset://sounds/switch.wav", Volume = 0.6},
}

local function PlaySound(Name)
    if not Settings.SoundsEnabled then
        return
    end

    local Data = SoundIDs[Name]
    if not Data then
        return
    end

    local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    Sound.SoundId = Data.Id
    Sound.Volume = Data.Volume
    Sound.Parent = SoundService
    Sound:Play()

    task.delay(3, function()
        if Sound then
            Sound:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

-- Button shrinks when pressed, springs back on release, plays a click sound.
local function AddPressAnimation(Button, SoundName)
    local Scale = Button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or Instance.new("UIScale")
    Scale.Scale = 1
    Scale.Parent = Button

    Button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(
            Scale,
            TweenInfo.new(0.07, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Scale = 0.94}
        ):Play()
    end)

    local function Release()
        TweenService:Create(
            Scale,
            TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Scale = 1}
        ):Play()
    end

    Button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(Release)
    Button.MouseLeave:Connect(Release)

    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        PlaySound(SoundName or "Click")
    end)
end

    BaseGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.91

    BaseGlow.ZIndex = 13

local Rain = Instance.new("Frame")
Rain.Name = "Rain"
Rain.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
Rain.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Rain.ClipsDescendants = true
Rain.ZIndex = 4
Rain.Parent = Main

local function CreateRainDrop()
    if not Settings.RainEnabled or not Rain.Parent then
        return
    end

    local Drop = Instance.new("Frame")
    Drop.Name = "Drop"

    local height = math.random(18, 48)
    local width = math.random(1, 2)

    Drop.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
    Drop.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(-10, 110) / 100, 0, -0.1, 0)
    Drop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 175, 255)
    Drop.BackgroundTransparency = math.random(35, 72) / 100
    Drop.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Drop.Rotation = math.random(-8, 8)
    Drop.ZIndex = 4
    Drop.Parent = Rain

    local DropCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    DropCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    DropCorner.Parent = Drop

    local duration = math.random(55, 120) / 100
    local xShift = math.random(-25, 25) / 1000

    TweenService:Create(
        Drop,
        TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
        {
            Position = UDim2.new(
                Drop.Position.X.Scale + xShift,
                0,
                1.2,
                0
            ),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.94,
        }
    ):Play()

    task.delay(duration, function()
        if Drop then
            Drop:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

task.spawn(function()
    while Gui.Parent do
        if Settings.RainEnabled then
            for _ = 1, 2 do
                CreateRainDrop()
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.045)
    end
end)

local function CreateTab(Name, Text, Order)
    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Button.Name = Name
    Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 45)
    Button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10 + (Order - 1) * 55)
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 24, 34)
    Button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
    Button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Button.Text = Text
    Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 180)
    Button.TextSize = 13
    Button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    Button.ZIndex = 12
    Button.AutoButtonColor = false
    Button.Parent = Sidebar

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    Corner.Parent = Button

    local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 85, 120)
    Stroke.Transparency = 0.75
    Stroke.Parent = Button

    Tabs[Name] = Button
    AddPressAnimation(Button, "Click")

    Button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if Button.BackgroundColor3 ~= Color3.fromRGB(55, 65, 90) then
            TweenService:Create(
                Button,
                TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(33, 39, 55)}
            ):Play()
        end
    end)

    Button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if Button.BackgroundColor3 ~= Color3.fromRGB(55, 65, 90) then
            TweenService:Create(
                Button,
                TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 24, 34)}
            ):Play()
        end
    end)

    return Button
end

local function SwitchPage(Name)
    for PageName, Page in pairs(Pages) do
        local Show = PageName == Name
        if Show and not Page.Visible then
            Page.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
            Page.Visible = true
            TweenService:Create(
                Page,
                TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)}
            ):Play()
        else
            Page.Visible = Show
        end
    end

    for TabName, Button in pairs(Tabs) do
        local Selected = TabName == Name
        TweenService:Create(
            Button,
            TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {
                BackgroundColor3 = Selected
                    and Color3.fromRGB(55, 65, 90)
                    or Color3.fromRGB(20, 24, 34),
                TextColor3 = Selected
                    and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    or Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 180),
            }
        ):Play()
    end
end

for Name, Button in pairs(Tabs) do
    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        SwitchPage(Name)
    end)
end

local function CreateToggle(Page, Text, Y, Default, Callback)
    local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 42)
    Button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, Y)
    Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 31)
    Button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Button.Text = ""
    Button.ZIndex = 12
    Button.AutoButtonColor = false
    Button.Parent = Page

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    Corner.Parent = Button

    local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(62, 73, 97)
    Stroke.Transparency = 0.68
    Stroke.Parent = Button

    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -65, 1, 0)
    Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 0)
    Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Label.Text = Text
    Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 223, 230)
    Label.TextSize = 13
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Label.ZIndex = 13
    Label.Parent = Button

    local Status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Status.Size = UDim2.new(0, 45, 1, 0)
    Status.Position = UDim2.new(1, -55, 0, 0)
    Status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Status.TextSize = 11
    Status.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    Status.ZIndex = 13
    Status.Parent = Button

    local State = Default

    local StatusScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    StatusScale.Parent = Status

    local function Update(Animate)
        Status.Text = State and "ON" or "OFF"
        Status.TextColor3 = State
            and Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 150)
            or Color3.fromRGB(120, 125, 135)

        local TargetColor = State
            and Color3.fromRGB(25, 38, 38)
            or Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 31)

        if Animate then
            TweenService:Create(
                Button,
                TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {BackgroundColor3 = TargetColor}
            ):Play()

            StatusScale.Scale = 1.6
            TweenService:Create(
                StatusScale,
                TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Scale = 1}
            ):Play()
        else
            Button.BackgroundColor3 = TargetColor
        end
    end

    AddPressAnimation(Button, "Toggle")

    Button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(
            Button,
            TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 44)}
        ):Play()
    end)

    Button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(
            Button,
            TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 42)}
        ):Play()
    end)

    Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        State = not State
        Update(true)
        Callback(State)
    end)

    Update()
    return Button
end

local function CreateSlider(Page, Text, Y, Min, Max, Default, Callback)
    local Holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    Holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 65)
    Holder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, Y)
    Holder.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 22, 31)
    Holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Holder.ZIndex = 12
    Holder.Parent = Page

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    Corner.Parent = Holder

    local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(62, 73, 97)
    Stroke.Transparency = 0.68
    Stroke.Parent = Holder

    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 28)
    Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 3)
    Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Label.Text = Text
    Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 223, 230)
    Label.TextSize = 12
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Label.ZIndex = 13
    Label.Parent = Holder

    local Value = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Value.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 28)
    Value.Position = UDim2.new(1, -95, 0, 3)
    Value.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Value.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 150, 255)
    Value.TextSize = 12
    Value.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    Value.ZIndex = 13
    Value.Parent = Holder

    local Bar = Instance.new("Frame")
    Bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 5)
    Bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 46)
    Bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 65)
    Bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Bar.ZIndex = 13
    Bar.Parent = Holder

    local BarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    BarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    BarCorner.Parent = Bar

    local Fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    local InitialPercent = math.clamp((Default - Min) / math.max(Max - Min, 0.0001), 0, 1)
    Fill.Size = UDim2.new(InitialPercent, 0, 1, 0)
    Fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 130, 255)
    Fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Fill.ZIndex = 14
    Fill.Parent = Bar

    local FillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    FillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    FillCorner.Parent = Fill

    local Knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    Knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    Knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
    Knob.Position = UDim2.new(InitialPercent, 0, 0.5, 0)
    Knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 225, 255)
    Knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Knob.ZIndex = 15
    Knob.Parent = Bar

    local KnobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    KnobCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    KnobCorner.Parent = Knob

    local Dragging = false
    local LastNumber = Default

    local function FormatNumber(Number)
        if Max - Min >= 10 then
            return math.floor(Number + 0.5)
        end
        return math.floor(Number * 100 + 0.5) / 100
    end

    local function SetValue(X)
        local Percent = math.clamp(
            (X - Bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(Bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1),
            0,
            1
        )

        local Number = FormatNumber(Min + (Max - Min) * Percent)
        LastNumber = Number
        local FinalPercent = math.clamp((Number - Min) / math.max(Max - Min, 0.0001), 0, 1)

        Fill.Size = UDim2.new(FinalPercent, 0, 1, 0)
        Knob.Position = UDim2.new(FinalPercent, 0, 0.5, 0)
        Value.Text = tostring(Number)
        Callback(Number)
    end

    Bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)
        if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            Dragging = true
            PlaySound("Click")
            TweenService:Create(
                Knob,
                TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)}
            ):Play()
            SetValue(Input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)
        if Dragging and Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            SetValue(Input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(Input)
        if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            if Dragging then
                TweenService:Create(
                    Knob,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)}
                ):Play()
            end
            Dragging = false
        end
    end)

    Value.Text = tostring(LastNumber)
    Callback(LastNumber)
    return Holder
end

--========================================================
-- NEON ANIMATION LOOP
--========================================================

local NeonTime = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    NeonTime += dt
    if not Settings.NeonAnimations then
        return
    end

    local hue = (NeonTime * 0.055) % 1
    local neonColor = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.78, 1)

    RTXLabel.TextColor3 = neonColor
    NeonTitle.TextColor3 = neonColor
    NeonTitle.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromHSV((hue + 0.08) % 1, 0.9, 1)
    NeonTitleGlow.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV((hue + 0.03) % 1, 0.85, 1)
    NeonTitleGlow.TextStrokeColor3 = neonColor
    NeonTitleGlow.TextTransparency = 0.55 + 0.16 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(NeonTime * 2.4))
    MainStroke.Color = neonColor
    AccentTop.BackgroundColor3 = neonColor

    for i, Stroke in ipairs(NeonGlows) do
        Stroke.Color = Color3.fromHSV((hue + i * 0.045) % 1, 0.8, 1)
    end

    Reflection.Position = UDim2.new((math.sin(NeonTime * 0.65) * 0.55) + 0.25, 0, -0.3, 0)

    for _, item in ipairs(CornerRays) do
        if item.part.Parent then
            item.part.BackgroundColor3 = neonColor
            item.part.BackgroundTransparency = 0.54 + 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(NeonTime * 2.8 + item.phase))
        end
    end

    for _, info in ipairs(Bushes) do
        if info.part.Parent then
            info.part.Rotation = info.base + math.sin(NeonTime * 1.4 + info.phase) * 7
        end
    end
end)

FOVCircle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Settings.FOV * 2, Settings.FOV * 2)

--========================================================
-- ESP
--========================================================

local ESPObjects = {}

local function RemoveESP(Player)
    local Object = ESPObjects[Player]
    if Object then
        if Object.Highlight and Object.Highlight.Parent then
            Object.Highlight:Destroy()
        end
        if Object.Billboard and Object.Billboard.Parent then
            Object.Billboard:Destroy()
        end
    end
    ESPObjects[Player] = nil
end

local function CreateESP(Player)
    if Player == LocalPlayer then
        return
    end

    local Character = Player.Character
    if not Character then
        return
    end

    RemoveESP(Player)

    local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    Highlight.Name = "RSR_ESP"
    Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.72
    Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    Highlight.FillColor = Settings.ESPColor
    Highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
    Highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    Highlight.Adornee = Character
    Highlight.Parent = Character

    local Head = Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local Billboard

    if Head then
        Billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        Billboard.Name = "RSR_ESP_Name"
        Billboard.Adornee = Head
        Billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 35)
        Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
        Billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        Billboard.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        Billboard.Parent = Head

        local NameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        NameLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        NameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        NameLabel.Text = Player.DisplayName
        NameLabel.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
        NameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
        NameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        NameLabel.TextSize = 13
        NameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        NameLabel.Parent = Billboard
    end

    ESPObjects[Player] = {
        Highlight = Highlight,
        Billboard = Billboard,
    }
end

local function ApplyESPToAll()
    if not Settings.ESP then
        return
    end

    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer and Player.Character then
            CreateESP(Player)
        end
    end
end

for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if Player ~= LocalPlayer then
        Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.25)
            if Settings.ESP then
                CreateESP(Player)
            end
        end)
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(Player)
    Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.25)
        if Settings.ESP then
            CreateESP(Player)
        end
    end)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
    RemoveESP(Player)
end)

--========================================================
-- TRACERS
--========================================================

local TracerFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
TracerFolder.Name = "RSR_Tracers"
TracerFolder.Parent = Gui

local Tracers = {}

local function CreateTracer(Player)
    if Player == LocalPlayer then
        return nil
    end

    local Line = Instance.new("Frame")
    Line.Name = Player.Name
    Line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    Line.BackgroundColor3 = Settings.TracerColor
    Line.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Line.Visible = false
    Line.ZIndex = 90
    Line.Parent = TracerFolder

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    Corner.Parent = Line

    return Line
end

for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    Tracers[Player] = CreateTracer(Player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(Player)
    Tracers[Player] = CreateTracer(Player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
    if Tracers[Player] then
        Tracers[Player]:Destroy()
    end
    Tracers[Player] = nil
end)

--========================================================
-- AIM TARGET
--========================================================

local function GetClosestTarget()
    local Closest = nil
    local ClosestDistance = math.huge

    local Center = Vector2.new(
        Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
        Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2
    )

    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local Character = Player.Character
            local Head = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if Head and Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local Position, Visible = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Head.Position)

                if Visible and Position.Z > 0 then
                    local ScreenPosition = Vector2.new(Position.X, Position.Y)
                    local Distance = (ScreenPosition - Center).Magnitude

                    if Distance <= Settings.FOV and Distance < ClosestDistance then
                        ClosestDistance = Distance
                        Closest = Head
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return Closest
end

--========================================================
-- FLY
--========================================================

local FlyVelocity
local FlyConnection

local function StartFly()
    if FlyConnection then
        FlyConnection:Disconnect()
        FlyConnection = nil
    end

    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not Character then
        return
    end

    local Root = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not Root then
        return
    end

    if FlyVelocity then
        FlyVelocity:Destroy()
    end

    FlyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    FlyVelocity.Name = "RSR_FlyVelocity"
    FlyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    FlyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    FlyVelocity.Parent = Root

    FlyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Settings.FlyEnabled or not Root.Parent then
            return
        end

        local Direction = Vector3.zero

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            Direction += Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            Direction -= Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            Direction -= Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            Direction += Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            Direction += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
            Direction -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end

        if Direction.Magnitude > 0 then
            Direction = Direction.Unit
        end

        FlyVelocity.Velocity = Direction * Settings.FlySpeed
    end)
end

local function StopFly()
    if FlyConnection then
        FlyConnection:Disconnect()
        FlyConnection = nil
    end

    if FlyVelocity then
        FlyVelocity:Destroy()
        FlyVelocity = nil
    end
end

--========================================================
-- HEAD HITBOX (LOCAL VISUAL)
--========================================================

local OriginalHeadSizes = {}

local function UpdateHeadHitbox(Player)
    if Player == LocalPlayer then
        return
    end

    local Character = Player.Character
    if not Character then
        return
    end

    local Head = Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not Head or not Head:IsA("BasePart") then
        return
    end

    if not OriginalHeadSizes[Player] then
        OriginalHeadSizes[Player] = Head.Size
    end

    local OriginalSize = OriginalHeadSizes[Player]

    if Settings.Hitbox <= 0 then
        Head.Size = OriginalSize
        return
    end

    local Scale = 1 + (Settings.Hitbox * 0.35)
    Head.Size = Vector3.new(
        OriginalSize.X * Scale,
        OriginalSize.Y * Scale,
        OriginalSize.Z * Scale
    )
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
    OriginalHeadSizes[Player] = nil
end)

--========================================================
-- FIRST PERSON ARM DISTANCE
--========================================================

local ArmJointCache = {}

local function GetArmJoints(Character)
    local Joints = {}

    local UpperTorso = Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
    if UpperTorso then
        local Left = UpperTorso:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder")
        local Right = UpperTorso:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder")
        if Left and Left:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Left)
        end
        if Right and Right:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Right)
        end
    end

    local Torso = Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if Torso then
        local Left = Torso:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder")
        local Right = Torso:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder")
        if Left and Left:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Left)
        end
        if Right and Right:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Right)
        end
    end

    return Joints
end

local function IsFirstPerson()
    if not Camera then
        return false
    end

    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local Head = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not Head then
        return false
    end

    return (Camera.CFrame.Position - Head.Position).Magnitude < 1.1
end

local function UpdateArmDistance()
    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not Character then
        return
    end

    local Joints = ArmJointCache[Character]
    if not Joints then
        Joints = GetArmJoints(Character)
        ArmJointCache[Character] = Joints
    end

    local Active = Settings.ArmsEnabled and IsFirstPerson()

    for _, Joint in ipairs(Joints) do
        if Joint.Parent then
            if not Joint:GetAttribute("RSR_OriginalCached") then
                Joint:SetAttribute("RSR_OriginalCached", true)
                Joint:SetAttribute("RSR_OriginalC0", tostring(Joint.C0))
            end

            -- Use a local Transform for a safer visual offset during first-person.
            if Active then
                local direction = Joint.Name:lower():find("left") and -1 or 1
                Joint.Transform = CFrame.new(direction * Settings.ArmDistance * 0.18, 0, -Settings.ArmDistance * 0.08)
            else
                Joint.Transform = CFrame.identity
            end
        end
    end
end

--========================================================
-- INVISIBILITY
--========================================================

local InvisibleOriginals = {}

local function RememberInvisible(instance, property)
    InvisibleOriginals[instance] = InvisibleOriginals[instance] or {}
    if InvisibleOriginals[instance][property] == nil then
        local ok, value = pcall(function() return instance[property] end)
        if ok then
            InvisibleOriginals[instance][property] = value
        end
    end
end

local function ApplyInvisibleToCharacter(character)
    if not character then return end

    for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            RememberInvisible(descendant, "LocalTransparencyModifier")
            pcall(function() descendant.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end)
        elseif descendant:IsA("Decal") or descendant:IsA("Texture") then
            RememberInvisible(descendant, "Transparency")
            pcall(function() descendant.Transparency = 1 end)
        end
    end
end

local function RemoveInvisibleFromCharacter(character)
    for instance, properties in pairs(InvisibleOriginals) do
        if instance and instance.Parent then
            for property, value in pairs(properties) do
                pcall(function() instance[property] = value end)
            end
        end
    end
    InvisibleOriginals = {}
end

local function UpdateInvisibility()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if Settings.Invisible then
        ApplyInvisibleToCharacter(character)
    else
        RemoveInvisibleFromCharacter(character)
    end
end

--========================================================
-- BETTER FPS OPTIMIZER
--========================================================

local FPSOriginals = {}
local FPSDescendantConnection
local FPSLightingOriginals = {
    GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
}

local function RememberProperty(Instance, Property)
    FPSOriginals[Instance] = FPSOriginals[Instance] or {}
    if FPSOriginals[Instance][Property] == nil then
        local ok, value = pcall(function()
            return Instance[Property]
        end)
        if ok then
            FPSOriginals[Instance][Property] = value
        end
    end
end

local function OptimizeInstance(Instance)
    if not Settings.BetterFPSEnabled then
        return
    end

    if Instance:IsA("Decal") or Instance:IsA("Texture") then
        RememberProperty(Instance, "Transparency")
        pcall(function()
            Instance.Transparency = 1
        end)
    elseif Instance:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or Instance:IsA("Trail") or Instance:IsA("Beam")
        or Instance:IsA("Smoke") or Instance:IsA("Fire") or Instance:IsA("Sparkles") then
        RememberProperty(Instance, "Enabled")
        pcall(function()
            Instance.Enabled = false
        end)
    elseif Instance:IsA("BloomEffect") or Instance:IsA("SunRaysEffect")
        or Instance:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or Instance:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect")
        or Instance:IsA("BlurEffect") then
        RememberProperty(Instance, "Enabled")
        pcall(function()
            Instance.Enabled = false
        end)
    end
end

local function EnableBetterFPS()
    Settings.BetterFPSEnabled = true
    FPSLightingOriginals.GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = false

    for _, Descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        OptimizeInstance(Descendant)
    end

    for _, Descendant in ipairs(Lighting:GetDescendants()) do
        OptimizeInstance(Descendant)
    end

    if FPSDescendantConnection then
        FPSDescendantConnection:Disconnect()
    end

    FPSDescendantConnection = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(Instance)
        task.defer(function()
            OptimizeInstance(Instance)
        end)
    end)
end

local function DisableBetterFPS()
    Settings.BetterFPSEnabled = false

    if FPSDescendantConnection then
        FPSDescendantConnection:Disconnect()
        FPSDescendantConnection = nil
    end

    for Instance, Properties in pairs(FPSOriginals) do
        if Instance and Instance.Parent then
            for Property, Value in pairs(Properties) do
                pcall(function()
                    Instance[Property] = Value
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    FPSOriginals = {}
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = FPSLightingOriginals.GlobalShadows
end

-- Watch the setting in case the UI callback is edited later.
local PreviousBetterFPS = Settings.BetterFPSEnabled
local PreviousInvisible = Settings.Invisible

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if Settings.Invisible ~= PreviousInvisible then
        PreviousInvisible = Settings.Invisible
        UpdateInvisibility()
    elseif Settings.Invisible then
        ApplyInvisibleToCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if Settings.BetterFPSEnabled ~= PreviousBetterFPS then
        PreviousBetterFPS = Settings.BetterFPSEnabled
        if Settings.BetterFPSEnabled then
            EnableBetterFPS()
        else
            DisableBetterFPS()
        end
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- MAIN LOOP
--========================================================

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera or Camera

    -- FOV circle
    FOVCircle.Visible = Settings.FOVEnabled
    if Settings.FOVEnabled then
        FOVCircle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Settings.FOV * 2, Settings.FOV * 2)
        FOVStroke.Color = Settings.FOVColor
        FOVGlow.Color = Settings.FOVColor
    end

    -- Neon / mirror animation
    if Settings.NeonAnimations then
        local Pulse = (math.sin(os.clock() * 3) + 1) / 2
        GlassStroke.Transparency = 0.58 + Pulse * 0.2
    else
        GlassStroke.Transparency = 0.72
    end

    Reflection.Visible = Settings.MirrorEnabled
    if Settings.MirrorEnabled and Settings.NeonAnimations then
        local sweep = (os.clock() % 2.8) / 2.8
        Reflection.Position = UDim2.new(-0.35 + sweep * 1.55, 0, -0.25, 0)
    end

    -- ESP: stays active after respawns while ON
    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then
            if Settings.ESP then
                if not ESPObjects[Player] then
                    CreateESP(Player)
                else
                    local Object = ESPObjects[Player]

                    if Object.Highlight and Object.Highlight.Parent then
                        Object.Highlight.FillColor = Settings.ESPColor
                        Object.Highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
                    end

                    if Object.Billboard and Object.Billboard.Parent then
                        local Label = Object.Billboard:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
                        if Label then
                            Label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                if ESPObjects[Player] then
                    RemoveESP(Player)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Tracers
    for Player, Line in pairs(Tracers) do
        if Line and Line.Parent then
            if not Settings.Tracers then
                Line.Visible = false
            else
                local Character = Player.Character
                local Root = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                if Root then
                    local Position, Visible = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Root.Position)
                    if Visible then
                        local Start = Vector2.new(
                            Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
                            Camera.ViewportSize.Y
                        )
                        local Finish = Vector2.new(Position.X, Position.Y)
                        local Difference = Finish - Start
                        local Length = Difference.Magnitude

                        Line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
                            (Start.X + Finish.X) / 2,
                            (Start.Y + Finish.Y) / 2
                        )
                        Line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Length, 2)
                        Line.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(Difference.Y, Difference.X))
                        Line.BackgroundColor3 = Settings.TracerColor
                        Line.Visible = true
                    else
                        Line.Visible = false
                    end
                else
                    Line.Visible = false
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Speed
    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if Humanoid then
        if Settings.SpeedEnabled then
            Humanoid.WalkSpeed = Settings.Speed
        else
            Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        end
    end

    -- Spin
    if Settings.SpinEnabled and Character then
        local Root = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if Root then
            Root.CFrame = Root.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Settings.SpinSpeed), 0)
        end
    end

    -- Aim assist
    if Settings.AimAssist then
        local AimPressed = UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Settings.AimKey)
        if AimPressed then
            local Target = GetClosestTarget()
            if Target then
                local CameraPosition = Camera.CFrame.Position
                local TargetCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(CameraPosition, Target.Position)
                Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(TargetCFrame, Settings.AimSmoothness)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Local head visual
    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then
            UpdateHeadHitbox(Player)
        end
    end

    -- First-person arms
    UpdateArmDistance()
end)

--========================================================
-- FLY STATE
--========================================================

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if Settings.FlyEnabled then
        if not FlyVelocity then
            StartFly()
        end
    else
        if FlyVelocity then
            StopFly()
        end
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- CAMERA FOV ENFORCEMENT
--========================================================

RunService:BindToRenderStep("RSR_CameraFOV", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
    if not Camera then
        return
    end

    local ActualFOV = math.clamp(Settings.CameraFOV, 80, NATIVE_FOV_MAX)
    if math.abs(Camera.FieldOfView - ActualFOV) > 0.05 then
        Camera.FieldOfView = ActualFOV
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- K = OPEN / CLOSE
--========================================================

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input, GameProcessed)
    if GameProcessed then
        return
    end

    if Input.KeyCode == Settings.OpenKey then
        Settings.GuiOpen = not Settings.GuiOpen
        PlaySound("Click")

        if Settings.GuiOpen then
            Main.Visible = true
            Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -400, 0.5, -235)
            MainScale.Scale = 0.9
            TweenService:Create(
                MainScale,
                TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Scale = 1}
            ):Play()

            TweenService:Create(
                Main,
                TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -400, 0.5, -270),
                }
            ):Play()
        else
            TweenService:Create(
                Main,
                TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                {
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -400, 0.5, -235),
                }
            ):Play()

            TweenService:Create(
                MainScale,
                TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                {Scale = 0.9}
            ):Play()

            task.delay(0.2, function()
                if not Settings.GuiOpen then
                    Main.Visible = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- RESPAWN
--========================================================

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Character)
    ArmJointCache[Character] = nil

    task.wait(0.6)

    if Settings.FlyEnabled then
        StartFly()
    end

    if Settings.ESP then
        ApplyESPToAll()
    end

    if Settings.Invisible then
        task.wait(0.15)
        UpdateInvisibility()
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- INITIAL STATE
--========================================================

if Settings.CameraFOV then
    Camera.FieldOfView = math.clamp(Settings.CameraFOV, 80, NATIVE_FOV_MAX)
end

Main.Visible = true

print("RSR STUDIO SHOOTER PANEL ENHANCED LOADED")
print("Press K to open / close")

perfLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
perfLabel.TextSize = 12
perfLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
perfLabel.Parent = perfFrame
local fpsFrames = 0
local fpsLast = tick()
R.RenderStepped:Connect(function() fpsFrames = fpsFrames + 1 end)
task.spawn(function()
    while perfFrame.Parent do
        local now = tick()
        local fps = math.floor(fpsFrames / math.max(now - fpsLast, 0.001))
        fpsFrames = 0
        fpsLast = now
        local ping = 0
        pcall(function()
            ping = math.floor(game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue())
        end)
        perfLabel.Text = string.format("FPS: %d | Ping: %d ms", fps, ping)
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

            TextColor3=(tab==active) and Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) or Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)

local function stopFly()
    fly=false
    if flyAnimTrack then pcall(function() flyAnimTrack:Stop() end) flyAnimTrack=nil end
    if flyC then flyC:Disconnect() flyC=nil end
    local ch=LP.Character
    if ch then
        local hrp=ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then hrp.Anchored=false end
        local hm=ch:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if hm then hm.PlatformStand=false end
    end
end

local function startFly()
    local ch = getCh()
    local hrp = ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hm = ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    hm.PlatformStand = true
    hrp.Anchored = true
    local animator = hm:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if animator then
        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://507766666"
        local track = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
        track.Looped = true
        track:Play()
        flyAnimTrack = track
    end
    local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local plrControls
    local ok2, res = pcall(function() return require(plr.PlayerScripts.PlayerModule.ControlModule) end)
    if ok2 then plrControls = res end
    flyC = R.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not fly then return end
        if not plrControls then return end
        local h2 = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not h2 then return end
        local moveDir = plrControls:GetMoveVector()
        local camCF = C.CFrame
        local newPos = h2.Position
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
            local camRotation = camCF - camCF.Position
            local direction = camRotation * moveDir
            newPos = newPos + direction.Unit * (flySpd * 0.05)
        end
        h2.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, newPos + camCF.LookVector)
    end)
end

local function isTeammate(p)
    if not teamCheckOn then return false end
    if not LP.Team then return false end
    if not p.Team then return false end
    return LP.Team == p.Team

local function getBodyPart(char, boneName)
    if not char then return nil end
    if boneName == "Head" then
        return char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    else
        return char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    end

local function isVisibleFromCamera(part)
    if not wallCheckOn then return true end
    if not part then return false end
    local cam = C
    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local targetPos = part.Position
    local dir = (targetPos - origin)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LP.Character}
    local result = W:Raycast(origin, dir, params)
    if not result then return true end
    return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(part.Parent)
end

local function getPriorityPlayer(players)
    if #players == 0 then return nil end
    if aimPriority == "Nearest" then
        local myHrp = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myHrp then return players[1] end
        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in pairs(players) do
            local hrp = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local d = (hrp.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = p, d end
            end
        end
        return best
    elseif aimPriority == "Lowest HP" then
        local best, bestHP = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in pairs(players) do
            local hm = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hm and hm.Health < bestHP then best, bestHP = p, hm.Health end
        end
        return best
    elseif aimPriority == "Closest to Crosshair" then
        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        local center = C.ViewportSize / 2
        for _, p in pairs(players) do
            local part = getBodyPart(p.Character, aimBone)
            if part then
                local sp, onScreen = C:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                    if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = p, d end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    return players[1]
end

local function getPlayersInFov()
    local list = {}
    local center = C.ViewportSize / 2
    for _, p in pairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LP and p.Character then
            if not isTeammate(p) then
                local part = getBodyPart(p.Character, aimBone)
                if part and isVisibleFromCamera(part) then
                    local sp, onScreen = C:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                        if d <= aimFov then
                            table.insert(list, p)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return list
end

if aimPredictionOn then

mkLabel(CombatPage,"HITBOX")

local hitboxOn = false
local hitboxSize = 5
local hitboxConns = {}

local function restoreHitbox(p)
    local char = p.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp and hrp:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") then
        hrp.Size = hrp:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig")
    end
    for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") then
            part.Size = part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig")
            local masslessAttr = part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrigMassless")
            local canCollideAttr = part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrigCanCollide")
            if masslessAttr ~= nil then part.Massless = masslessAttr end
            if canCollideAttr ~= nil then part.CanCollide = canCollideAttr end
        end
    end
end

local function applyHitbox(p)
    if p == LP then return end
    local char = p.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then
        if not hrp:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") then
            hrp:SetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig", hrp.Size)
        end
        hrp.Size = hrp:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") + Vector3.new(hitboxSize, hitboxSize, hitboxSize)
    end
    for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= hrp and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            if not part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") then
                part:SetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig", part.Size)
                part:SetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrigMassless", part.Massless)
                part:SetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrigCanCollide", part.CanCollide)
            end
            local orig = part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig")
            part.Size = orig + Vector3.new(hitboxSize, hitboxSize, hitboxSize)
            part.CanCollide = false
            part.Massless = true
        end
    end
end

mkTog(CombatPage,"Hitbox Expander",function(on)
    hitboxOn = on
    for _, c in pairs(hitboxConns) do c:Disconnect() end
    hitboxConns = {}
    if on then
        for _, p in pairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP then
                applyHitbox(p)
                local c = p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    if hitboxOn then applyHitbox(p) end
                end)
                table.insert(hitboxConns, c)

        table.insert(hitboxConns, newConn)
        notify("Hitbox Expander: ON")
    else
        for _, p in pairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP then restoreHitbox(p) end
        end
        notify("Hitbox Expander: OFF")
    end
end)

do
mkLabel(WorldPage,"WEATHER (Can Cause lag and fps drops)")

local weatherInstances = {}
local weatherConn = nil
local weatherParts = {}
local weatherPartSpeed = 0
local weatherPartSway = false
local thunderActive = false
local rainSound = nil

local function track(inst)
    table.insert(weatherInstances, inst)
    return inst
end

local function spawnLightningBolt(basePos)
    local boltFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    boltFolder.Name = "RichieBolt"
    boltFolder.Parent = W
    track(boltFolder)
    local startPos = basePos + Vector3.new(math.random(-120,120), 260, math.random(-120,120))
    local endPos = basePos + Vector3.new(math.random(-40,40), 25, math.random(-40,40))
    local segments = 14
    local points = {}
    for i = 0, segments do
        local t = i / segments
        local pos = startPos:Lerp(endPos, t)
        if i > 0 and i < segments then
            pos = pos + Vector3.new(math.random(-8,8), 0, math.random(-8,8))
        end
        table.insert(points, pos)
    end
    for i = 1, #points - 1 do
        local p1 = points[i]
        local p2 = points[i+1]
        local mid = (p1 + p2) / 2
        local dist = (p2 - p1).Magnitude
        local seg = Instance.new("Part")
        seg.Anchored = true
        seg.CanCollide = false
        seg.CanQuery = false
        seg.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        seg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(230,230,255)
        seg.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, dist)
        seg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mid, p2)
        seg.Parent = boltFolder
    end
    task.delay(0.25, function()
        if boltFolder and boltFolder.Parent then boltFolder:Destroy() end
    end)
end

local function stopWeather()
    thunderActive = false
    if weatherConn then weatherConn:Disconnect() weatherConn=nil end
    for _, inst in pairs(weatherInstances) do
        if inst and inst.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                if inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then inst:Clear() end
                inst:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    weatherInstances = {}
    weatherParts = {}
    weatherPartSpeed = 0
    weatherPartSway = false
    if rainSound then rainSound:Stop() rainSound:Destroy() rainSound=nil end
    L.FogStart = origFogStart
    L.FogEnd = origFogEnd
    L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(192,192,192)
    L.Brightness = origBright
    local atm = L:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
    if atm then atm.Density = 0.3 atm.Haze = 0 end
end

local function buildRain(hrp, count, isSnow)
    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = isSnow and "RichieSnow" or "RichieRain"
    folder.Parent = W
    track(folder)
    local base = hrp.Position
    for i = 1, count do
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        if isSnow then
            p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            p.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
            p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            p.Transparency = 0.15
        else
            p.Size = Vector3.new(0.15, 0.15, 3)
p.Orientation = Vector3.new(90, 0, 0)
            p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180,200,255)
            p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            p.Transparency = 0.35
        end
        p.Anchored = true
        p.CanCollide = false
        p.CanQuery = false
        p.CanTouch = false
        p.Parent = folder
        p.Position = Vector3.new(
            base.X + math.random(-200,200),
            base.Y + math.random(20,200),
            base.Z + math.random(-200,200)
        )
        table.insert(weatherParts, p)
    end
    weatherPartSpeed = isSnow and 0.6 or 8
    weatherPartSway = isSnow
end

local function startWeather(kind)
    stopWeather()
    if kind == "Clear" then notify("Weather: Clear") return end
    local ch = LP.Character or LP.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local hrp = ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
    if not hrp then notify("Character not ready") return end

    if kind == "Fog" then
        L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,205)
        L.FogStart = 0
        L.FogEnd = 60
        local atm = L:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
        if atm then atm.Density = 1 atm.Haze = 5 atm.Glare = 0 atm.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,205) end
        notify("Weather: Fog")
        return
    end

    if kind == "Rain" or kind == "Thunder" then
        buildRain(hrp, 250, false)
        rainSound = Instance.new("Sound")
        rainSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9064263922"
        rainSound.Volume = 0.6
        rainSound.Looped = true
        rainSound.Parent = SG
        rainSound:Play()
        track(rainSound)
        L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(120,130,140)
        L.FogStart = 0
        L.FogEnd = 250

        if kind == "Thunder" then
            L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,40)
            L.FogEnd = 180
            L.Brightness = 0.4
            thunderActive = true
            task.spawn(function()
                while thunderActive do
                    task.wait(math.random(3,7))
                    if not thunderActive then break end
                    local c = LP.Character
                    local h = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if h then spawnLightningBolt(h.Position) end
                    local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
                    flash.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
                    flash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
                    flash.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    flash.ZIndex = 999
                    flash.Parent = SG
                    L.Brightness = 7
                    task.wait(0.06)
                    flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
                    L.Brightness = 2.5
                    task.wait(0.06)
                    flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
                    L.Brightness = 5
                    task.wait(0.05)
                    flash:Destroy()
                    L.Brightness = 0.4
                    local thunder = Instance.new("Sound")
                    thunder.SoundId = "rbxassetid://139968319088532"
                    thunder.Volume = 1
                    thunder.Parent = SG
                    thunder:Play()
                    task.spawn(function()
                        task.wait(6)
                        if thunder then thunder:Destroy() end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end
        notify("Weather: "..kind)
    elseif kind == "Snow" then
        buildRain(hrp, 320, true)
        L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(220,225,235)
        L.FogStart = 0
        L.FogEnd = 300
        notify("Weather: Snow")
    end

    weatherConn = R.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local c = LP.Character
        if not c then return end
        local h = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not h then return end
        local base = h.Position
        local sway = tick()
        for _, p in pairs(weatherParts) do
            if p and p.Parent then
                local np = p.Position - Vector3.new(0, weatherPartSpeed, 0)
                if weatherPartSway then
                    np = np + Vector3.new(math.sin(sway + p.Position.X) * 0.05, 0, math.cos(sway + p.Position.Z) * 0.05)
                end
                if np.Y < base.Y - 20 then
                    np = Vector3.new(
                        base.X + math.random(-200,200),
                        base.Y + 150,
                        base.Z + math.random(-200,200)
                    )
                elseif (np - base).Magnitude > 350 then
                    np = Vector3.new(
                        base.X + math.random(-200,200),
                        base.Y + 150,
                        base.Z + math.random(-200,200)
                    )
                end
                p.Position = np
            end
        end
    end)
end

mkBtn(WorldPage,"Rain",function() startWeather("Rain") end)
mkBtn(WorldPage,"Snow",function() startWeather("Snow") end)
mkBtn(WorldPage,"Fog",function() startWeather("Fog") end)
mkBtn(WorldPage,"Thunder",function() startWeather("Thunder") end)
mkBtn(WorldPage,"Clear Weather",function() startWeather("Clear") end)
_G.richieWeatherCleanup = stopWeather

end
