local CONFIG_INDEX=CONFIG_FOLDER.."/index.txt"
pcall(function()
    if not isfolder(CONFIG_FOLDER) then makefolder(CONFIG_FOLDER) end
end)

local function getConfigList()
    local list={}
    pcall(function()
        if isfile(CONFIG_INDEX) then
            local content=readfile(CONFIG_INDEX)
            for name in content:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
                table.insert(list, name)
            end
        end
    end)
    return list
end

local function saveConfigList(list)
    pcall(function()
        writefile(CONFIG_INDEX, table.concat(list, "\n"))
    end)
end

local saveInp=mkInp(ConfigPage,"Enter config name...")

mkBtn(ConfigPage,"Save Config",function()
    local name=saveInp.Text
    if not name or name=="" then
        saveInp.Text="Name required!"
        return
    end
    local data={}
    for k,v in pairs(savedValues) do data[k]=v end
    local jsonStr="{"
    local first=true
    for k,v in pairs(data) do
        if not first then jsonStr=jsonStr.."," end
        jsonStr=jsonStr..'"'..k..'":'..tostring(v)
        first=false
    end
    jsonStr=jsonStr.."}"
    pcall(function()
        writefile(CONFIG_FOLDER.."/"..name..".cfg", jsonStr)
        local list=getConfigList()
        local found=false
        for _,n in pairs(list) do if n==name then found=true break end end
        if not found then
            table.insert(list, name)
            saveConfigList(list)
        end
    end)
    saveInp.Text="Saved: "..name
end)

                    local content=readfile(path)
                    for k,v in content:gmatch('"([^"]+)":([%a%d%.%-]+)') do
                        local num=tonumber(v)
                        if num then savedValues[k]=num
elseif v=="true" then savedValues[k]=true

local function resolveTarget(q)
    if not q or q=="" then return nil,"" end
    q=q:lower()
    for _,p in pairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if p~=LP and p.Name:lower()==q then return p,p.Name end
    end
    local m={}
    for _,p in pairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if p~=LP and p.Name:lower():sub(1,#q)==q then table.insert(m,p) end
    end
    if #m==1 then return m[1],m[1].Name end
    if #m==0 then return nil,"" end
    return nil,"user not found."
end

mkBtn(targetContainer,"Fling Target",function()
    local tg = _G.richieTarget
    if not tg or not tg.Character then notifyRed("No target selected") return end
    local myCh = LP.Character
    if not myCh then return end
    local myHum = myCh:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local myRoot = myHum and myHum.RootPart
    if not myHum or not myRoot then notifyRed("Character not ready") return end
    local TChar = tg.Character
    if not TChar then notifyRed("Target has no character") return end
    local THum = TChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local TRoot = THum and THum.RootPart
    local THead = TChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local Acc = TChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory")
    local Handle = Acc and Acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if not TChar:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") then notifyRed("Target invalid") return end
    local oldFPDH = W.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
    local oldPos = myRoot.CFrame
    notify("Flinging "..tg.Name.."...")
    local FPos = function(BasePart, Pos, Ang)
        myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(BasePart.Position) * Pos * Ang
        myCh:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(BasePart.Position) * Pos * Ang)
        myRoot.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e7, 9e7 * 10, 9e7)
        myRoot.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
    end
    local SFBasePart = function(BasePart)
        local TimeToWait = 2
        local Time = tick()
        local Angle = 0
        repeat
            if myRoot and THum then
                if BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
                    Angle = Angle + 100
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + THum.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + THum.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + THum.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + THum.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + THum.MoveDirection, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + THum.MoveDirection, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                else
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, THum.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -THum.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, THum.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                end
            end
        until Time + TimeToWait < tick()
        W.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0/0
        local BV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        BV.Parent = myRoot
        BV.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        BV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
        pcall(function() myHum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false) end)
        -- if block removed
        -- removed
        -- removed
        BV:Destroy()
        pcall(function() myHum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true) end)
        pcall(function() myHum:ChangeState("GettingUp") end)
        for _, part in pairs(myCh:GetChildren()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.Velocity = Vector3.new()
                part.RotVelocity = Vector3.new()
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
pcall(function()
    myHum.PlatformStand = false
    myHum.Sit = false
    myHum.WalkSpeed = savedValues["speed"] or 16
    myHum.JumpPower = savedValues["jump"] or 50
    myHum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
end)
myRoot.Anchored = true
myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
myRoot.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
myRoot.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
myRoot.CFrame = oldPos
pcall(function() myCh:PivotTo(oldPos) end)
task.wait(0.15)
myRoot.Anchored = false
        W.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = oldFPDH
        notify("Fling done")
    end
    task.spawn(function()

    end)
end)

local function onKeyPress(input)
    if not listeningForKey then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
    local key=input.KeyCode
    local btn=listeningBtn
    if unsupportedKeys[key] then
        btn.Text="Not Allowed"
        btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80)
        task.wait(1)
        btn.Text="+"
        btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,220,220)
        listeningForKey=nil
        listeningBtn=nil
        return
    end
    if key==Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end
    for otherFeature, boundKey in pairs(keybindData) do
        if otherFeature ~= listeningForKey and boundKey == key then
            btn.Text="In Use"
            btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80)
            task.wait(1)
            btn.Text="+"
            btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,220,220)
            listeningForKey=nil
            listeningBtn=nil
            return
        end
    end
    keybindData[listeningForKey] = key
    btn.Text=key.Name
    btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(80,200,120)
    listeningForKey=nil
    listeningBtn=nil
end

U.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
    if listeningForKey then
        onKeyPress(input)
        return
    end
    for featureName, key in pairs(keybindData) do
        if input.KeyCode==key then
            if keybindTargets[featureName] then
                local tgt=keybindTargets[featureName]
                local current = _G.richieToggleState[featureName]
                if current == nil then current = false end
                local newState = not current
                _G.richieToggleState[featureName]=newState
                tgt.setState(newState)
                if tgt.onChange then tgt.onChange(newState) end
                notify(featureName .. ": " .. (newState and "ON" or "OFF"))
            elseif keybindButtons[featureName] then
                local info=keybindButtons[featureName]
                if info.fire then info.fire() end
                notify(featureName .. ": fired")
            end
        end
    end
end)

local SelectedPlayer = nil

local function UpdateAvatar(player)

	if not player then
		Avatar.Image = ""
		return
	end

	local ok,url = pcall(function()

		return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(
			player.UserId,
			Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,
			Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100
		)

	end)

	if ok then
		Avatar.Image = url
	end

end

local function UpdatePreview()

	local name = SelectedPlayer and SelectedPlayer.DisplayName or "You"
	local msg = MessageBox.Text

	if msg == "" then
		msg = "..."
	end

	Preview.Text = "   " .. name .. ": " .. msg

end

local function RefreshPlayers()

	for _,child in ipairs(Dropdown:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextButton") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		Button.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,38)
		Button.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL
		Button.Text = "  " .. player.DisplayName .. "  @" .. player.Name
		Button.TextColor3 = WHITE

			PlayerButton.Text =

			PlayerButton.TextColor3 = WHITE

			UpdateAvatar(player)
			UpdatePreview()

			Dropdown.Visible = false

		end)

	end

	Dropdown.CanvasSize =
		UDim2.fromOffset(0,Layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 15)

end

		SelectedPlayer = nil
		PlayerButton.Text = "👤  Select a player..."
		PlayerButton.TextColor3 = GRAY
		Avatar.Image = ""
		UpdatePreview()
	end

	RefreshPlayers()

end)

--==================================================

local function ShowMessage(target,message)

	if not target or message == "" then
		return
	end

	-- Chat window
	local channels = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")

	if channels then

		local general = channels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")

		if general then

			general:DisplaySystemMessage(
				"<font color='#FFFFFF'>" ..
				target.DisplayName ..
				": " ..
				message ..
				"</font>"
			)

		end

	end

	-- Bubble
	local character = target.Character

	if character then

		local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")

		if head then
			TextChatService:DisplayBubble(head,message)
		end

	end

end

Send.Activated:Connect(function()

	-- Blank player = yourself
	local target = SelectedPlayer or LP
	local message = MessageBox.Text

	if message == "" then

		Send.Text = "⚠  TYPE A MESSAGE"

		task.wait(.8)

		Send.Text = "⚡  SEND TO CHAT + BUBBLE"

		return
	end

	ShowMessage(target,message)

	MessageBox.Text = ""

	Send.Text = "✓  SENT"

	TweenService:Create(
		Send,
		TweenInfo.new(.12),
		{Size = UDim2.new(1,-45,0,48)}
	):Play()

	task.wait(.15)

	TweenService:Create(
		Send,
		TweenInfo.new(.12),
		{Size = UDim2.new(1,-30,0,55)}
	):Play()

	task.wait(.5)

	Send.Text = "⚡  SEND TO CHAT + BUBBLE"

end)

		and UDim2.fromOffset(470,72)
		or UDim2.fromOffset(470,410)

end)

	Main.Visible = true
	Reopen.Visible = false

end)

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING — MOBILE + PC
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos

Top.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = Main.Position

	end

end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if not dragging then
		return
	end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		Main.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)

	end

end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = false

	end

end)

-- START
--==================================================

RefreshPlayers()
UpdatePreview()
